legal_source_precedence: Current 2026 FSSAI CTR compiled Version IX is official-hosted review text; the original notified Gazette and effective amendments govern discrepancies. May 2026 amendment is future-effective on 2026-12-01.

official_sources.caution: Related article text, never an approval for the 13 commercial matrices.
Effective only from 2026-12-01, none of the thirteen has a direct named-family amendment flag in existing Batch47.

09.001 excludes fat >=40% and milk powder; 09.006 is chromium selenium molybdenum in specific nutritional products and nickel serves as internal standard; conflicting manual numbering/adoption remains unresolved.
Method presence alone is not accredited current use for specific matrix and analyte.

dockets.product_name: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine

legal_comparator.label: Lead row for packaged drinking water (other than mineral water); not a proven legal article for outlet-dispensed vending water.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Operator process description, outlet vs sealed pack, original water source, point-of-sale label and sampling point.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Signed decision whether dispensed-vending product is packaged drinking water, an IS 10500 product or another current legal article; keep 0.01 mg/L packaged-water row as comparison only.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Water-matrix lead method with LOQ, outlet sampling and chain-of-custody; not automatically a general food digestion method.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Water dispensed from a vending machine needs water-method scope and a legal drinking-water versus packaged-water assessment. A generic food digest method is not automatically valid.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need sale format (dispensed cup/bottle), water source, whether item is legally packaged drinking water and sample taken from tap/outlet.

legal_comparator.label: Lead rows for ready-to-use infant formula and infant foods; intended-age children supplement is not proven to be either.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Final label, intended child age, directions/reconstitution, age eligibility, product formulation, registration category.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Signed classification under current special nutrition rules and exact current lead article on as-sold/reconstituted basis.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Lead (not chromium) method with accredited child-supplement matrix, LOQ, and actual lot basis.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Age, intended use and final product class must be established first; 09.006 measures chromium, not the current lead comparator, and infant-formula category does not automatically follow.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need target age range, product label, FSMP/FSDU status, manufacturer designation and ready-to-use versus powder basis.

legal_comparator.label: Copper row for pulp and pulp products of any fruit; raw seedless tamarind flesh is not proven processed pulp.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Supplier product specification and photos proving seedless flesh, milled pulp, puree or concentrate, moisture and additions.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Signed copper article for the exactly marketed seedless tamarind and fruit-processing state.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Copper method verified against actual tamarind acid/moisture matrix and LOQ; published approximate 09.001 capability is not achieved LOQ.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Method 09.001 lists approximate copper capability of 3 mg/kg, not a lab LOQ. Verify seedless pulp/form, method detection below applicable limit and whole-to-pulp legal comparator.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need to know whole deseeded pulp flesh vs manufactured fruit pulp, water content, salt/preservative additions and origin.

legal_comparator.label: Lead row for milks with concentration factor for dehydrated dairy milks; coconut product is not that article on its name alone.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Complete manufacturer BOM showing coconut fat, added sodium caseinate/dairy proteins if any, spray-dried form and fat percentage.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Signed product classification and lead article for marketed coconut milk powder, not blanket dairy milk concentration factor.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Quantify fat: 09.001 scope excludes ≥40% fat foods and milk powder; validate separate lead extraction/digestion and matrix scope.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Determine true coconut/non-dairy composition, fat content and matrix. 09.001 excludes dairy milk powder and high-fat food; whether its exclusions apply to this commercial coconut matrix requires laboratory evidence.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need coconut vs dairy protein/fat sources, dehydration concentration factor and registered category; non-dairy coconut powder is not ordinary milk.

legal_comparator.label: Cocoa-powder lead row on dry fat-free substance basis; not a whole fermented/dried cocoa-bean legal article.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Whole fermented bean vs nib/roasted form, harvest origin, moisture/fat, sample homogenization SOP.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Written lead legal article for cocoa beans, independent of powdered cocoa dry-fat-free limit.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Representative whole-bean grinding/homogenization, lead digestion scope, fat threshold and test-result basis.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Whole cocoa beans must not adopt cocoa-powder CTR article or dry fat-free reporting basis. Verify whole-bean sample preparation, bean origin and legal article.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need beans raw/roasted whole or nibs, fat and moisture; powder-specific dry fat-free metal basis not transferred.

dockets.product_name: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars

legal_comparator.label: Cocoa-powder lead row on dry fat-free basis; not automatically a sugar-containing blended dry cocoa mix.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: As-sold cocoa solids, sugar, fat, moisture, particle structure, pack presentation and ingredient BOM.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Specific lead article and basis for dry mixtures of cocoa and sugars; no dilution/ratio or cocoa-powder rule transfer without authority.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Matrix validation for sugar and cocoa fat ratio, homogeneity, digestion, spike recovery, LOQ and correct dry/fat-free conversions.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Complete cocoa/sugar/fat proportion and as-sold moisture basis required before interpreting 09.001 fat exclusion or dry fat-free basis.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need cocoa solids%, sugar%, fat%, packing state and whether finished mix can legally be read as cocoa powder.

dockets.product_name: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake

legal_comparator.label: Cocoa-powder lead row on dry fat-free substance basis; does not by itself cover cocoa mass/liquor or cocoa press cake.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Actual cocoa mass/liquor vs press cake, batch fat percentage, processing state and moisture.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Signed lead article and test reporting basis for the actual liquor or cake; prohibit powder-row auto-application.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Check 09.001 ≥40% fat exclusion for liquor; laboratory-approved higher-fat matrix preparation, LOQ and recovery required.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Determine cocoa mass/liquor versus cocoa cake and actual fat %. 09.001 cannot be used if >=40% fat; no cocoa-powder contaminant row transferred.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need cocoa mass/liquor vs press cake vs de-oiled powder, fat% and dry/fat-free conversion method.

legal_comparator.label: Chromium row for refined sugar (0.02 mg/kg) exists; misri crystal product has not been shown to meet that article.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Crystal type/production route, refined sugar proof, total ash vs sulphated ash, test material representation.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Signed finding whether the particular misri lot is refined sugar for chromium law; no assumption from appearance.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: 09.006 targets Cr/Se/Mo in infant/nutrition products; obtain chromium-specific validated method for sugar crystals and LOQ below signed limit.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: 09.006 chromium method scope is infant/nutritional products, not sugar crystals; request actual validated chromium method (e.g., verified 09.003 if sensitivity sufficient) and a signed sugar comparator determination.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need crystal sugar origin, refined/pressed vs rock sugar identity and tested ash; chromium row names refined sugar.

dockets.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized

legal_comparator.label: Nickel row for sorbitol (2 mg/kg); not a generic nickel comparator for every polyol/mixture.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Exact INS/CAS/isomer and supplier grade for each polyol; composition and percentage of blends.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Nickel legal article for each actual compound or properly classified blend; no sorbitol rule transfer to xylitol, erythritol or mixed polyols.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: 09.006 uses nickel as an internal standard rather than measuring nickel; separate nickel assay and matrix scope required.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Nickel in 09.006 is an internal standard, not the analyte. A named polyol and Ni-validated method with adequate LOQ are needed; 09.003 wavelength mention is not proof of accuracy.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need individual INS/CAS polyol; sorbitol Ni row cannot apply to xylitol/erythritol blend.

dockets.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products

legal_comparator.label: Lead rows for milks and secondary milk products; pure/formulated colostrum not proven to be either current CTR article.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Bovine/buffalo source and colostrum collection stage, concentrate vs mixed supplement, dehydrated form, fat and solids.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Independently signed lead article for actual colostrum product and concentration or reconstitution basis.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: A dairy minerals method that omits lead is insufficient; require validated lead-specific colostrum powder/liquid analysis.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: FSSAI dairy method 0.010:2023 is a mineral panel that omits lead. Ask for separate validated lead test and colostrum product form and legal article.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need colostrum source, pure vs formulated concentrate and dehydration factor, distinct from ordinary milk.

legal_comparator.label: Veterinary-drug/residue provisions contain substance and commodity scope: no single 'antibiotics in royal jelly' row has been approved from a category label.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Royal-jelly source and bee production records, formulation/purity and named suspected antibiotic(s).
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Named antibiotic molecule, current legal honey/bee-product or other article and applicable restriction/prohibition provision.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Accredited named-antibiotic method and LOQ for royal jelly's protein/fat/water matrix; no honey-to-royal-jelly transfer.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Royal jelly is not automatically honey; name the antibiotic compound, actual bee-source matrix and species-specific residue method and legal scope.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need honey vs royal jelly classification, drug chemical and bee-production evidence; animal tissue/honey mapping conditional.

legal_comparator.label: Lead row for milks is not proof of a lead limit for Ayurveda Aahara 14.3 cooked coconut-and-milk recipe.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Actual labeled Narikela Ksheerika manufacturer recipe, coconut and cow milk proportions, solids/fat, food license.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Signed current Ayurveda Aahara authorization/identity and separate legal lead article for finished marketed sweet.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Finished cooked heterogeneous coconut-dairy matrix lead method, fat check, sampling and LOQ.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Prove real coconut/milk recipe and fat %, sample basis, correct matrix method, regulatory article and licensing; an official recipe does not validate method or commercial formulation.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need approved Ayurveda Aahara product identity, coconut/milk recipe and real marketed form; classical recipe not milk article.

legal_comparator.label: Lead row for milks is not proof for Ayurveda Aahara 14.7 milk-and-flower infusion sweet.

dockets.next_manufacturer_document: Actual buffalo milk, aromatic flower species, water, sugar, finished solids/fat and licensed commercial presentation.
dockets.next_regulatory_decision: Exact authorized Ayurveda Aahara finished-product identity and independently signed lead legal article, not milk analogy.
dockets.next_lab_method_document: Validate test for cooked milk/botanical mixture with fat/moisture basis, spikes, LOQ, batch sampling.
dockets.historical_matrix_exception: Buffalo milk and flower infusion require actual batch formula, botanical identity, fat %, method validation and dry/fresh reporting basis; ordinary milk limits are not automatically assigned.
dockets.historical_legal_exception: Need buffalo milk, aromatic flower, sugar/water composition and licencing; dairy content alone is not finished milk article.
